videos.caption: We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

A rare genetic mutation called pseudo-melanism has resulted in roughly half of the tigers in India's Similipal Tiger Reserve sporting coats with far more black than those of usual tigers. This widespread coloration is a symptom of a shallow gene pool in a region that previously faced a dwindling tiger population, and could prove catastrophic if conservation officers aren't able to find these tigers more genetically diverse mates. "EL TIGRE NO RUGE POR MIEDO… RUGE POR RESPETO" El tigre no necesita estar en manada para ser poderoso. Su fuerza está en su soledad, en su paso firme, en esa mirada que atraviesa la selva como si supiera que nada ni nadie puede detenerlo. Es el símbolo de la elegancia feroz, de la calma antes de la tormenta… y de la tormenta misma. No ataca sin razón. No corre detrás de todo. Elige. Observa. Espera. Porque el tigre sabe que la paciencia también es parte de la fuerza. No le interesa impresionar, le basta con ser. Su rugido no busca asustar: busca recordar que hay cosas en la vida que no se pueden domar. Que hay almas que nacieron para ser libres. Si tú sientes que no encajas, que eres distinto, que no necesitas gritar para ser escuchado… quizás llevas a un tigre en el alma. No te apagues para ser aceptado. No te escondas para encajar. Porque así como el tigre no cambia sus rayas… tú tampoco tienes que cambiar tu esencia. El mundo no necesita más personas iguales.
